negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, smooth CGI plastic, 3D digital render, Pixar style, Disney style, real human skin pores, photorealistic human skin, young person, modern spectacles, neon lights, cold blue tint, deformed hands, extra fingers, cartoon drawing, 2D illustration
reconstruction_priority: tactile stop-motion physical textures (matte clay skin, real fiber hair, chunky wool knitwear) — AI frequently replaces with smooth CGI plastic
exact facial morphology (oversized circular black glasses, prominent elongated nose, wide cupped ears) — AI tends to normalize into standard human proportions
precise macro depth-of-field falloff (sharp eyes/glasses with gently blurred raised hand and background) — AI often renders uniform flat sharpness across all planes
warm 3000K nostalgic interior lighting and vintage suitcase contents — AI frequently generates generic modern clutter
